Performance Test Engineer 
Pune, Maharashtra, India | Full-time | Fully remote
 Responsibilities: 

• Performing Feature and Performance Testing for software releases includes -feature understanding, perform and participate in requirement gathering

• Customizing/creating a test environment, developing test plans, running automated and manual tests, analyzing test results, and reporting issues/bugs

• Creating and applying new approaches, concepts to improve the Automation coverage, productivity, and efficiency of testing practices

• Maintaining and enhancing our large-scale, distributed test environment

• Be able to design testing tools, which includes developing scripts to enhance regression testing

 Requirements: 

• 4 to 5 years of experience in testing cloud-based web applications.

• Be hands-on UNIX command line, utilities, and tools (Awk, Sed knowledge is plus) usage

• Demonstrate good knowledge of scripting languages such as Python or Shell and SQL

 APPLY HERE: 
 Helping startups & midsize enterprises adopt cloud-native tech with our products and services. #Containers #Kubernetes #CloudNative Experts.
 We are working with Bay area-based startups helping them build container orchestration/networking/storage/security products. And on another hand we work with enterprises helping Automotive, FinTech, Energy companies adopt Kubernetes and container ecosystem to modernize their applications and infrastructure.
We are a premier technology company comprising of elite software programmers coupled with have strong experience in Serverless, Container, Container Orchestration, Cloud platforms, Infrastructure automation, SDN, Big Data Infrastructure Solutions. 
 We are 1st Kubernetes Partner in India, only other in APAC region.
Our deep expertise and focus in these areas enable our customers to build better software, faster.
 We are organizers of local chapters of Serverless & Kubernetes Meetup and actively involved in building a community for new technologies in Cloud & DevOps space.
